events.subtitle: Carter & Cleveland
events.factual_description: Wolf Trap presents Jason Carter and Michael Cleveland at The Barns in Vienna, Virginia on Saturday, November 21, 2026 at 8:00 PM; doors open at 6:30 PM. Wolf Trap describes Carter and Cleveland as two of bluegrass's most acclaimed fiddle virtuosos and frames the performance around their first collaborative album, Carter & Cleveland. The Grand Ole Opry's artist profile independently documents the project as the culmination of more than 30 years of friendship and musical cross-pollination and notes that the album won 2025 IBMA Album of the Year. The Wolf Trap page does not publish additional personnel, so no backing musicians are inferred here.

en.why_it_matters: The attraction is not an awards pileup so much as the way two very different fiddle voices meet. Carter carries the Del McCoury lineage with a deep sense of bluegrass phrasing and ensemble time; Cleveland brings a huge tone, velocity and a five-string vocabulary that can widen the harmony without leaving the tradition. Their first joint record finally makes that long friendship the center of the music, and The Barns is small enough for bow attack, harmony and rhythmic push-pull to matter physically.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for this local date if fiddle, acoustic virtuosity or bluegrass lineage is part of the listening thread. The project is touring, so there is no need to treat the Vienna stop as scarce, but the scale of The Barns makes it a particularly good place to hear the instrumental conversation up close.
en.listen_before: Michael Cleveland & Jason Carter — Carter & Cleveland

es.why_it_matters: Lo atractivo no es la montaña de premios sino escuchar cómo se encuentran dos voces de fiddle muy distintas. Carter carga el linaje de Del McCoury con una manera profundísima de frasear y de colocar el tiempo dentro del ensamble; Cleveland trae un sonido enorme, velocidad y un vocabulario de cinco cuerdas que puede ensanchar la armonía sin salirse de la tradición. Su primer disco conjunto por fin pone en el centro esa amistad musical de décadas, y la escala de The Barns permite escuchar muy de cerca el ataque del arco, las armonías y el empuje rítmico entre los dos.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente a esta fecha local si el fiddle, el virtuosismo acústico o el linaje bluegrass forman parte del hilo de escucha. El proyecto está de gira, así que no hace falta tratar la parada de Vienna como una rareza, pero The Barns tiene una escala especialmente buena para escuchar esa conversación instrumental de cerca.

events.factual_description: Wolf Trap presents Red Baraat at The Barns in Vienna, Virginia on Saturday, November 7, 2026 at 8:00 PM; doors open at 6:30 PM. The official venue page identifies dhol player Sunny Jain as the band's leader and describes Red Baraat's sound as a fusion of North Indian Punjabi rhythms with hip-hop, jazz, funk and Go-Go. Wolf Trap also notes the band's 2025 album Bhangra Rangeela. The primary event page does not publish the full November 7 personnel, so no additional lineup is inferred.

Exact authorized purchase destination linked from the Wolf Trap event page.

en.why_it_matters: Red Baraat earns a RADAR slot because rhythm is not accompaniment here; it is the whole architecture. Sunny Jain's dhol drives a band language where Punjabi procession energy, brass-band weight, funk, hip-hop and Go-Go can occupy the same pulse. In The Barns, that usually festival-sized physicality gets compressed into a room where the drum attack and brass response should be impossible to ignore.
en.trip_verdict: Worth knowing about and taking if the local night is open, especially for groove, percussion or cross-cultural band language. Red Baraat tours regularly and this is a return to The Barns, so I would fit it around rarer one-off performances rather than move a stronger anchor to make room.

es.why_it_matters: Red Baraat entra al RADAR porque aquí el ritmo no acompaña: es la arquitectura completa. El dhol de Sunny Jain empuja un lenguaje de banda donde la energía procesional punjabí, el peso de los metales, el funk, el hip-hop y el go-go pueden vivir sobre el mismo pulso. En The Barns, esa energía que normalmente se siente de festival queda comprimida en una sala donde el golpe del tambor y la respuesta de los metales deberían sentirse físicamente.
es.trip_verdict: Vale tenerla en el tablero y entrarle si la noche local está libre, sobre todo si el groove, la percusión o los cruces culturales forman parte del hilo. Red Baraat gira con regularidad y ésta es una vuelta a The Barns, así que la acomodaría alrededor de encuentros más raros en vez de mover una fecha-ancla más fuerte.
